_comment: Change-type -> required-artifact routing for TrackPoli. check-change-routing.mjs fires a rule when the PR's added/changed files match its 'when' globs, then requires each 'requires' artifact in the SAME change (or a valid, dated waiver). Globs are scoped to TrackPoli's OWN source (src/**, supabase/**) and to *.sql, so they never fire on the vendored engine under .claude/skills/** or on always-on/**. '**' spans directories; '*' and '?' do not cross '/'. A rule keyed on 'added' needs --added-list (CI computes it).

rules.description: A Supabase schema change is a decision and a deployment risk. Record the why (ADR) and let the migration-safety gate prove it is expand-and-contract safe.

requires.hint: record why the schema changed under docs/adr/
the migration file itself, carrying an expand-and-contract, concurrent-index, safe NOT NULL path

rules.description: A change to authentication, sessions, or access control must ship a @security scenario that exercises the control (owasp-secure-coding-bdd).

requires.hint: add a @security Given/When/Then exercising the auth/access control

rules.description: A user-facing UI change must carry an accessibility verdict (universal-accessibility-wcag).

requires.hint: attach the axe run output or the manual WCAG checklist verdict for the changed surface

rules.description: Production source should not change without a test moving with it (bdd-comprehensive-testing + comprehensive-test-strategy).

requires.hint: add or update the test (or feature scenario) covering the changed behavior
